title: Tech Startup Pitch (Inno Pitch)
rules:
• Presentation Duration: 10 to 15 slides.
  • Focus: The proposed startup should be technology-driven, address a genuine community or societal problem, demonstrate innovation and practical feasibility.
  • Incorporate one or more technologies: AI, IoT, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Fintech, Healthcare, Education Tech, Agri-Tech, Big Data, Mobile Computing, GPS, AR/VR, Drones, Edge Computing, Wearable Technology, Blockchain, NLP, Green/Clean Technology, Robotics, Biometric Technology.

Presentation Format

The presentation (10–15 slides) should include:

  • Startup Title
  • Problem Statement
  • Proposed Technology-based Solution
  • Target Users/Customers
  • Key Features
  • Technology Used
  • Revenue/Business Model
  • Expected Social or Community Impact
  • Future Scope
  • References (if applicable)

Visuals, diagrams, mock-ups, or prototypes are encouraged.
judging:
• Innovation & Creativity – 10 points
  • Problem Relevance & Social Impact – 10 points
  • Technical Feasibility – 10 points
  • Business Viability – 10 points
  • Presentation Skills and Communication – 10 points
  • Response during Q&A – 10 points
  • Total: 60 points
